caption:
Swipe through. xAI just released the official Grok Bot 101 guide and five moves inside it change how you think about getting work done. 🤖

What Grok Bot actually is and why it works nothing like a regular chatbot, how to create your first one in 10 to 15 minutes with plain English, how to set three kinds of triggers so it runs without you sending a message, how the guide's author turned 900 X follows into a private searchable contact list using one bot, how to build teams of specialist bots that hand work to each other, and how to ship working software just by describing what you want.

Most people use AI as a search engine. Grok Bot has its own cloud computer and keeps going after you log off. The contact list got built. Software shipped overnight. People are handing full workflows to bots. Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

hook_sharpen.why: 900 followers overnight is specific and wild enough to make you stop cold and wonder how it's real. Just promising 15-minute setup without showing what actual payoff you get isn't as stopping.

editor_override: Hook misrepresents the core fact — TRUTH LAW + HOOK LAW: 'BUILT 900 FOLLOWS OVERNIGHT' reads as gaining 900 followers overnight. The actual story (slide 5) is that someone who was already following 800–900 X accounts used a Grok Bot to pull those profiles into a searchable contact list. Gaining followers and organizing an existing follow-list are opposite things. The hook makes a promise the slide
